summary: New bilateral edema-like airspace opacity with a larger left pleural effusion.

findings.rationale: Previously near-clear lungs now show bilateral perihilar/basal hazy opacities in a symmetric edema-like pattern, though lower-volume current technique contributes some crowding.
The left base shows much greater veiling opacity and costophrenic blunting than on prior, indicating larger pleural fluid; the right base may also have a small dependent component.
